image_description: A full suit of polished steel plate armor displayed on a mannequin or stand in an indoor setting (likely a museum). The armor includes a breastplate, pauldrons (shoulder guards), faulds (waist armor), and limb defenses. The breastplate is the central focus, featuring a high gloss finish with visible reflections. To the left and right foreground, parts of other armor pieces (possibly helmets or shields) are visible. The background consists of a wooden cabinet and a wall.
